language.name: English
reason.unknown: The companion refused this for a reason it has no sentence for yet: {token}.
profile.chat_qa.name: Chat Q&A
profile.chat_qa.description: Answers a chat message that mentions the companion's name.
profile.channel_points.name: Channel points
profile.channel_points.description: Reacts when a viewer redeems one custom reward you choose.
profile.spoken_keyword.name: Spoken keyword
profile.spoken_keyword.description: Listens to your microphone and answers when you say the wake word.
profile.silent.name: Silent
profile.silent.description: Connects to your channel's chat but never answers: every trigger is off.
instance.already_running: The companion is already running for this profile; opening it: {url}
instance.version_mismatch: Another version of the companion is already running for this profile: version {running} is running, and this launch is version {own}. Nothing was opened.
instance.version_mismatch.next: Close the running companion window and launch again, or open the running one manually at {url}
instance.record_exists: An instance record exists for this profile: {path}
instance.port.unauthenticated: Its recorded port {port} answers, but the check with the record's access token did not succeed.
instance.port.silent: Its recorded port {port} did not answer within 10 seconds.
instance.not_confirmed.cause: The companion that wrote the record may still be starting or stopping, or another program now uses that port, so this launch started nothing.
instance.not_confirmed.next: Use the companion window if one is open; otherwise wait and launch again, and if this report repeats, close the program holding process {pid} or restart the computer.
instance.unconfirmable: Its process {pid} is running but not answering to this launch: this platform cannot confirm that it is the companion, so this launch started nothing.
instance.unconfirmable.next: Use the companion window if one is open, on 127.0.0.1 port {port}; otherwise close the program holding process {pid} or restart the computer.
instance.stale: An earlier instance of the companion did not stop cleanly; its instance record was removed.
instance.unusable: The instance record {path} could not be read or written, so the companion did not start.
instance.unusable.next: Keep the profile on a local disk you can write to, then launch again.
platform.connected: Connected: the token names the Twitch channel {login}.
platform.connection_refused: The companion could not reach Twitch to check the access token.
platform.connection_refused.next: Check that this computer is connected to the internet, then select Check again.
platform.timeout: Twitch did not answer the token check within {seconds} seconds.
platform.timeout.next: Wait a moment and select Check again; if it keeps happening, check your internet connection.
platform.unauthorized: Twitch refused this access token: it is not valid, or it has expired.
platform.unauthorized.next: Generate a new access token for the account the companion speaks as, paste it, then select Check again.
platform.client_id_mismatch: This access token belongs to a different application than the client id you entered.
platform.client_id_mismatch.next: Paste the client id of the application that generated this token, or generate a new token with this client id.
platform.missing_scope: This access token lacks permissions this profile needs: {scopes}.
platform.missing_scope.next: Generate a new access token that grants every permission listed, paste it, then select Check again.
platform.malformed_answer: Twitch answered the token check with something the companion could not read.
platform.malformed_answer.next: Wait a moment and select Check again; nothing was changed.
rewards.connection_refused: The companion could not reach Twitch to read your channel's rewards.
rewards.connection_refused.next: Check that this computer is connected to the internet, then select Check again.
rewards.timeout: Twitch did not send your channel's rewards within {seconds} seconds.
rewards.timeout.next: Wait a moment and select Check again; if it keeps happening, check your internet connection.
rewards.unauthorized: Twitch refused to list your channel's rewards with this access token.
rewards.unauthorized.next: Generate the access token with the broadcaster's account, paste it, then select Check again.
rewards.malformed_answer: Twitch answered the reward list with something the companion could not read.
rewards.malformed_answer.next: Wait a moment and select Check again; nothing was changed.
rewards.no_rewards: Your channel has no custom channel-points reward yet.
rewards.no_rewards.next: Create the reward first in your Twitch creator dashboard, then select Check again.
model.answered: The model answered a real request.
model.not_needed: This profile never asks the model anything, so no model is needed.
model.connection_refused: The companion could not reach the model at the address you entered.
model.connection_refused.next: Check the endpoint address and that the model server is running, then select Check again.
model.timeout: The model did not answer within {seconds} seconds.
model.timeout.next: Check that the model is loaded and not busy, then select Check again.
model.unauthorized: The model endpoint refused the API key.
model.unauthorized.next: Paste a valid API key for this endpoint, then select Check again.
model.not_found: The model endpoint answered that this address or this model does not exist.
model.not_found.next: Check the endpoint address (a chat-completions address) and the model name, then select Check again.
model.not_a_completion: The address answered, but not with a chat completion.
model.not_a_completion.next: Enter the full address of a chat-completions endpoint, then select Check again.
model.empty_answer: The model answered with an empty text.
model.empty_answer.next: Choose another model or check the model's settings, then select Check again.
wizard.title: First-run setup
wizard.screen1.title: Language and profile
wizard.screen2.title: Your Twitch account
wizard.screen3.title: The model
wizard.screen4.title: Your profile
wizard.screen5.title: A dry run
wizard.language.label: Language
wizard.profile.choose: Choose what the companion does. You can change it later in the editor.
wizard.kept: kept: leave empty to keep the value you already entered
wizard.write: Write the profile and check it
wizard.profile_view.title: Your profile, read-only
wizard.check_passed: The profile was written and passed the configuration check.
wizard.dry_run.explain: The dry run sends one pretend event through your profile. Nothing is posted to your channel.
wizard.dry_run_completed: The dry run recorded run {run_id}, and it completed. Setup is finished.
wizard.dry_run_not_triggered: The dry run recorded run {run_id}: nothing was triggered ({reason}), as this profile intends. Setup is finished.
wizard.parameter.companion_name: Companion name (the word viewers write to call it)
wizard.parameter.reward_id: The reward the companion reacts to
wizard.parameter.wake_word: Wake word (what you say to call the companion)
wizard.credential.client_id: Client id of your Twitch application
wizard.credential.client_secret: Client secret of your Twitch application
wizard.credential.access_token: Access token of the account the companion speaks as
wizard.credential.transcription_api_key: API key of the transcription service
wizard.credentials.owner_only: Your credentials are kept in {directory}: a folder only your user account can open, so no other account on this computer can read them.
wizard.credentials.local_appdata: Your credentials are kept in {directory}: your account's local application data, which Windows keeps to your account.
wizard.order_refused: This step is not open yet: the step shown here has not passed.
wizard.order_refused.next: Complete this step first, then select Next step.
wizard.input_missing.next: Fill it in, then submit this step again.
wizard.input_invalid: What was entered for {field} could not be used.
wizard.input_invalid.next: Correct it, then submit this step again.
wizard.profile_unknown.next: Choose one of the four profiles, then submit this step again.
wizard.language_unknown.next: Choose one of the listed languages.
wizard.reward_not_picked.next: Choose the reward the companion reacts to, then select Check again.
wizard.generation_refused: The profile could not be built from what was entered.
wizard.generation_refused.next: Go back to the first step, check what you entered, and pass the steps again.
wizard.write_failed: The file {path} could not be written.
wizard.write_failed.next: Make sure the disk is not full and the folder is yours, then select the button again.
wizard.check_failed: The configuration check refused the generated profile.
wizard.check_failed.next: Go back to the first step, check what you entered, and pass the steps again.
wizard.check_failed_at: The configuration check refused the generated profile at the setting {field}.
wizard.check_failed_at.next: Go back to the step where you entered that setting, correct it, and pass the steps again.
wizard.dry_run_no_record: The dry run ended without recording a run.
wizard.dry_run_no_record.next: Select Start the dry run again; if it keeps happening, go back to the profile step.
wizard.dry_run_incomplete: The dry run returned a record that does not name its run, its outcome and this dry run.
wizard.dry_run_incomplete.next: Select Start the dry run again.
wizard.dry_run_unexpected: The dry run recorded a run, but not the outcome this profile should give.
wizard.dry_run_unexpected.next: Go back to the first step, check what you entered, and pass the steps again.
wizard.dry_run_timed_out: The dry run did not finish within {seconds} seconds.
wizard.dry_run_timed_out.next: Check that the model answers quickly, then select Start the dry run again.
wizard.state_unreadable: The setup progress file {path} could not be read.
wizard.state_unreadable.next: Remove or restore that file, then open the access address again.
wizard.refusal.credential_directory_unse: Windows names no local application data folder for your account, so your credentials were not stored anywhere.
Sign in with a regular Windows account, then select the button again.
wizard.refusal.credential_directory_unav: The folder {path} for your credentials does not exist or cannot be used, so your credentials were not stored anywhere.
Make sure that folder exists and is yours, then select the button again.
wizard.refusal.credential_directory_not_: The folder {path} for your credentials belongs to another account, so your credentials were not stored anywhere.
Make that folder yours, or remove it so it can be created again, then select the button again.
wizard.refusal.credential_directory_shar: Other accounts can write to the folder {path}, so your credentials were not stored anywhere.
Make that folder private to your account, then select the button again.
wizard.refusal.file_not_written_by_wizar: The file {path} was not written by this setup, so it was left untouched.
Change it in the editor instead, or move it away and select the button again.
wizard.refusal.file_changed_outside_wiza: The file {path} was changed outside this setup since it wrote it, so it was left untouched.
Make further changes in the editor.
wizard.refusal.profile_appeared: A profile appeared at {path} after this setup started, so it was left untouched.
wizard.refusal.profile_appeared.next: Open that profile in the editor, or move it away and select the button again.
console.title: Console
console.state.title: Is it working?
console.state.running_here: The companion is running, started from this window.
console.state.unsupervised: Another companion process is running; this window did not start it and does not control it.
console.modules.title: Modules
console.module.unknown: {module}: no state yet, the companion is not reporting.
console.module.degraded.next: Check this module's settings and credentials in the editor, then restart the companion.
console.feed.title: What just happened
console.fact.trigger_rejected: The trigger of {input} let it pass without answering.
console.fact.admission_rejected: The companion did not queue an answer.
console.grants.title: What the companion is allowed to do
console.grants.none: No grant is configured: the companion may run no action.
console.start.title: Start
console.stop.title: Stop
console.start.started: The companion started and reports ready.
console.start.started.next: Watch what happens below; Stop ends it.
console.start.unconfirmed: The companion was started but has not reported ready yet.
console.start.unconfirmed.next: Reload the console in a moment; if it still does not report ready, stop it and check its settings in the editor.
console.start.exited: The companion stopped while it was starting.
console.start.exited.next: Check the profile's settings and credentials in the editor, then start again.
console.start.launch_failed: The companion could not be launched.
console.start.launch_failed.next: Check that the companion is installed, then start again.
console.start.closing: This window is shutting down: nothing was started.
console.start.closing.next: Open the configuration window again, then start.
console.start.another_instance: Another instance is running: this window did not start it, so nothing was started.
console.start.another_instance.next: Stop that instance where it was started, then start again here.
console.start.running_here: The companion is already running from this window: nothing more was started.
console.start.running_here.next: Use Stop first if you want to start it again.
console.stop.unconfirmed: The companion did not end after it was asked to stop.
console.stop.unconfirmed.next: Try Stop again; if it still runs, end it from your system's task manager.
console.stop.not_ours: The running companion was not started from this window, so it was not stopped.
console.stop.not_ours.next: Stop it where it was started.
console.stop.nothing: Nothing to stop: this window has not started the companion.
console.revoke.title: Revoke
console.revoke.pending: The grant was removed. The companion is not running from this window, so the change takes effect at its next start.
console.revoke.pending.next: Start launches the companion without this grant.
console.revoke.applied: The grant was removed and the companion was restarted without it.
console.revoke.applied.next: Watch what happens below: the companion can no longer use this grant.
console.revoke.apply_refused: The grant was removed from the profile, but restarting the companion with the new profile failed.
console.revoke.apply_refused.next: Check the profile in the editor, then Stop and Start; a companion still running keeps the grant until it restarts.
console.revoke.apply_unknown: The grant was removed and the companion was restarted, but it has not reported ready yet.
console.revoke.apply_unknown.next: Reload the console in a moment; if it still does not report ready, stop it and check its settings in the editor.
console.revoke.unknown_rule: No single grant carries this rule: nothing was changed.
console.revoke.unknown_rule.next: Reload the console to see the current grants.
console.revoke.stale: The profile changed since this page was shown: nothing was changed.
console.revoke.stale.next: Reload the console, then revoke again.
console.revoke.not_written: The profile's settings file could not be written: nothing was changed.
console.revoke.not_written.next: Check that the profile's folder can be written to, then revoke again.
reason.family.audience: The author's role ({role}) is allowed by the trigger.
reason.family.audience_untrusted: The author's role ({role}) could not be confirmed by the platform, so the trigger ignored it.
reason.family.event_kind: The event kind ({kind}) is one the trigger answers.
reason.family.hook_error: The custom trigger {name} failed, so nothing was answered.
reason.family.hook_timeout: The custom trigger {name} took too long, so nothing was answered.
reason.family.hook_unavailable: The custom trigger {name} was busy, so nothing was answered.
reason.family.kind_mismatch: The trigger {name} does not answer this kind of event.
reason.family.probability_miss: The trigger {name} matched but its random draw said not this time.
reason.internal_trace: This was the companion's own report, not a message to answer.
reason.invalid_payload: The event arrived incomplete, so it was ignored.
reason.not_normalized: The event was in a format the companion does not read, so it was ignored.
reason.unauthenticated: The platform did not say who wrote it, so it was ignored.
reason.self_authored: The companion wrote this message itself, so it does not answer it.
reason.no_policy: No trigger is configured for this input.
reason.decision_pending: This event was already being decided.
reason.no_rule_matched: None of the trigger's rules matched.
reason.keyword_match: The message contains one of the trigger's words.
reason.keyword_no_match: The message contains none of the trigger's words.
reason.keyword_no_text: The message has no text to look for the trigger's words in.
reason.event_kind_no_match: The trigger does not answer this kind of event.
reason.probability_hit: The trigger's random draw said yes.
reason.probability_miss: The trigger's random draw said not this time.
reason.input_not_owned: Another module owns this input, so this one ignored it.
reason.session_queue_full: Too many answers were already waiting for this conversation.
reason.global_pending_cap: Too many answers were already waiting overall.
reason.session_cap: Too many conversations were already active.
reason.stale_drop: The answer waited too long and was dropped.
reason.run_deadline: The answer took longer than allowed and was stopped.
reason.cancelled: It was cancelled before it finished.
reason.missing_permission: A grant covers this action but lacks a permission it needs.
reason.not_authorized: No grant allows the companion to do this.
reason.unknown_action: The action is not one any enabled module provides.
reason.action_version_mismatch: The action was asked for in a version the module does not provide.
reason.unsupported_destination: The action cannot be done at that destination.
reason.invalid_arguments: The action was asked for with values it does not accept.
reason.invalid_result: The module answered the action with something unreadable.
reason.invalid_observation: The module's answer to the action was malformed.
reason.observation_too_large: The module's answer was too large to use.
reason.no_provider: No module is set up to do this action there.
reason.provider_not_ready: The module that does this action is not ready.
reason.provider_failed: The module that does this action failed.
reason.provider_closed: The module that does this action is shutting down.
reason.provider_unavailable: The service behind this action is not available.
reason.provider_refused: The service behind this action refused it.
reason.timed_out: It took too long and was stopped.
reason.timeout: The platform took too long to answer.
reason.external_effect_unknown: It is not known whether the action happened.
reason.call_id_conflict: The same action call was asked for twice with different contents.
reason.not_a_read_action: The companion may only read with this action, and this one would change something.
reason.malformed_arguments: The action was asked for with unreadable values.
reason.attachment_refused: An attached image or sound was refused.
reason.attachment_expired: An attached image or sound had expired.
reason.busy: The module was busy with another request.
reason.resource_busy: The resource was already in use.
reason.cooldown: It was done too recently; wait a little before asking again.
reason.rate_limited: The platform's rate limit was reached.
reason.rate_limited_platform: The platform's rate limit was reached.
reason.platform_forbidden: The platform does not allow the companion to do this.
reason.platform_unsupported: This platform does not offer this.
reason.upstream_status: The site answered with an error.
reason.text_too_long: The text was too long for the platform.
reason.quota_exhausted: The platform's daily quota is used up.
reason.no_live_chat: The channel has no live chat right now.
reason.auth_refresh_failed: The platform sign-in could not be renewed.
reason.proxy_disconnected: The connection to the remote companion was lost.
reason.unreachable: The automation software could not be reached.
reason.not_allowlisted: The automation action is not in the allowed list.
reason.instance_action_missing: The automation software has no action by that name.
reason.instance_action_ambiguous: The automation software has several actions by that name.
reason.capture_too_long: The recording was longer than allowed.
reason.voice_not_allowed: That voice is not one the module allows.
reason.output_not_allowed: That audio output is not one the module uses.
reason.tts_unavailable: Speech is not available right now.
reason.invalid_audio: The sound was not in a playable format.
reason.audio_too_large: The sound was too large to play.
reason.speech_too_long: The text to speak was too long.
reason.clip_unreadable: The sound clip could not be read.
reason.playback_failed: The sound could not be played.
reason.scene_not_allowed: That scene is not one the module allows.
reason.scene_unknown: The streaming software has no scene by that name.
reason.scene_not_applied: The scene change could not be confirmed.
reason.poll_active: A poll is already running on this channel.
reason.clip_not_created: The platform did not create the clip.
reason.no_viewer: There is no viewer to remember this for.
reason.store_failed: The memory could not be saved.
reason.operation_not_allowed: This moderation is not allowed by the channel's settings.
reason.target_unknown: The message to moderate is no longer in the recent chat.
reason.target_protected: The author of the message is protected from moderation.
reason.duration_out_of_range: The timeout duration is outside the allowed range.
reason.target_cooldown: This author was moderated too recently.
reason.host_not_allowed: That site is not in the allowed list.
reason.unsupported_scheme: That kind of address is not supported.
reason.too_many_redirects: The site redirected too many times.
reason.unsupported_content_type: The site answered with content the companion does not read.
reason.action_mismatch: The remote companion answered for a different action.
reason.agent_limit: Too many remote companions are already connected.
reason.auth_failed: The remote companion could not prove who it is.
reason.duplicate_call_unknown: The remote companion received this call twice and cannot say what happened.
reason.event_not_allowed: The remote companion sent an event it is not allowed to send.
reason.frame_too_large: A message from the remote companion was too large.
reason.invalid_frame: A message from the remote companion was malformed.
reason.unknown_frame: The remote companion sent a message of an unknown kind.
reason.unknown_session: The remote companion's session is no longer known.
reason.unsupported_protocol_version: The remote companion speaks a version this one does not support.
